eventName: 避難所3days〜脱出せよ食から学ぶ防災〜
description: ある日、突然地震が起きた――。あなたは避難所で何を思い、どう行動する？ 3日間の避難生活を体験しよう！
eventNameEn: 3 Days in a Shelter: Escape! Learning Disaster Preparedness Through Food
descriptionEn: One day, an earthquake suddenly strikes. What will you think and do at the evacuation shelter? Experience 3 days of shelter life!

description: カカオの実を収穫し、ガーナの楽器を作ろう！遊びや工作を楽しみながら、チョコレートの秘密や世界のことを学べる体験型企画です。
descriptionEn: Let’s find and harvest cocoa pods and make a traditional Ghanaian instrument! Through fun games and crafts, participants can discover the secrets of chocolate and learn about the world.

description: あなたは日本一の漁師。魚を求め海へ出たその時、突然の嵐で船が沈没！海底に散らばるアイテムを集め、仲間と協力して生還を目指せ！
eventNameEn: SEA BEAST 〜 Escape from the Depths〜
descriptionEn: You are Japan’s greatest fisherman. As you head out to sea in search of fish, a sudden storm strikes and your boat sinks! Gather scattered items from the ocean floor and work together with your friends to survive!

description: 参加者はブラック企業に閉じ込められた社員となり、数々のミッションや試練を乗り越えながら退職を目指す。教室全体を使った謎解きやミニゲームを通して、仲間と協力しながら脱出に挑戦する体験型企画である。
descriptionEn: Participants take on the role of employees trapped in a toxic company and aim to resign while overcoming various missions and challenges. Through puzzles and mini-games that make use of the entire classroom, participants will work together with their friends and attempt to escape. This is an interactive, hands-on experience designed to allow participants to immerse themselves in the story.

description: 海底の旅へようこそ！潜水艦に乗り込み、海底の的を狙ったり、謎を解いたりしながら大冒険！あなたの腕とひらめきで、最高得点を目指そう！
descriptionEn: Welcome to your underwater adventure! Hop aboard the submarine and set off on a grand adventure as you take aim at underwater targets and solve mysteries! Use your skills and ingenuity to aim for the highest score!

description: 結婚式を挙げられず、呪われた洋館を彷徨う花嫁の亡霊。館に散らばった品々を全てを見つけ出せるのか。恐怖の先に待つ、結婚式とは――。
descriptionEn: Trapped on her wedding day, the ghost of a bride haunts a cursed mansion. As you face the horrors hidden inside and search for her scattered wedding items, can you find them all? And what kind of wedding awaits at the end...?

description: 月食の夜に起きた殺人事件。その犯人は32人の中に潜んでいる。あなたは鑑識官になりきり、真相を暴くことができるのか？
descriptionEn: A murder took place on the night of a lunar eclipse. The killer is hiding among 32 people. Can you step into the role of a forensic investigator and uncover the truth?

description: 本校の制服を試着して記念撮影ができる特別企画！生徒会メンバーとの交流の場もあり、一足先に三田国際生を体験できます。
descriptionEn: Try on our official school uniform and take a commemorative photo! You can also chat with student council members and get a firsthand taste of life as a Mita International student.

description: 停電した学校を床発電で復旧せよ！発電した電力でLEDを灯し、クイズに挑戦しながら再生可能エネルギーを楽しく学ぶ体験型ミッション。
descriptionEn: Restore a school that has been hit by a power outage using floor-based electricity generation! Generate power by stepping on energy-harvesting floors to light up LEDs, and take on quiz challenges in an interactive mission that lets you have fun while learning about renewable energy.

eventName: S1D特命任務～宇宙ステーション潜入奪還作戦～
description: ライバル企業に奪われた新型宇宙船の設計図を取り戻すためいくつかのミッションを達成する、臨場感あふれる体験型アトラクションです！
eventNameEn: S1D Special Mission: Space Station Infiltration & Recovery Operation
descriptionEn: An immersive, interactive attraction where you’ll take on a series of missions to recover the blueprints for a cutting-edge spaceship stolen by a rival corporation!

description: 茶道のお点前をご覧になりながら、抹茶とお茶菓子を召し上がってみませんか？毎年大好評の茶道部によるお茶会を、今年も開催いたします！
チェスや将棋の対局を体験いただけます。入場時に実力を確認させて頂くため、経験の有無に関わらずお楽しみいただけます。
descriptionEn: Come and enjoy matcha & Japanese sweets while watching a traditional tea ceremony performance? Our annual tea gathering, hosted by the Tea Ceremony Club and always a favorite among visitors, will be held again this year!
Visitors can enjoy playing Chess and Shogi. We will confirm your skill level upon entry, so everyone, whether you have played it before or not, can have a great time.

description: 有名クイズ番組のパロディをはじめ、多彩なクイズに挑戦！
descriptionEn: Parodies of famous quiz shows, packed with unique challenges! Test your knowledge, wit, and luck across a variety of quiz types. Are you smarter than us?

eventName: 昆布観測島 〜電子のゆりかご〜
description: 「昆布観測島」では、部員たちがMIFのために制作した作品を展示・体験することができます。電子のゆりかごの世界をお楽しみください！
eventNameEn: Kombu Observation Island — The Cradle of Electrons —
descriptionEn: At our booth, you can view and experience our works which contains videos, video games, songs, and 3D models. Enjoy our world of the “Cradle of Electronics”!

eventName: サイエンス部2026 〜発光する宇宙スライム〜
description: 今年の実験テーマは暗闇で光る宇宙スライム！サイエンス部がお届けする三田国際科学学園らしい自由な実験を体験してみませんか？
descriptionEn: This year's theme is the glowing slime! Let’s explore the free spirited experiment of the Mita International School of Science!

description: 今年のMIFテーマに関連して、天体の名前が付けられている寝台列車をテーマにポスター展示、部品展示、Nゲージ運転体験を行います。
descriptionEn: In conjunction with this year's MIF theme, we will hold a poster exhibition, a display of train parts, and an N-gauge model train operating experience, all centered on the theme of sleeper trains named after celestial bodies.

description: 医療ミスが隠蔽された廃病院。真相を追い、封鎖病棟に足を踏み入れたあなたを、過去の恐怖と被害者の霊が待ち受ける____。
descriptionEn: An abandoned hospital is covering up for medical accidents. You will become an investigator to solve the hidden chart within the heart monitor’s time limit and escape!

eventName: 入居者募集中(ぎせいしゃぼしゅうちゅう)
description: 案内人と事故物件の調査に挑む体験型お化け屋敷。手元にある間取り図の違和感に気づいた時、逃げ場のない恐怖が襲いかかる。
descriptionEn: Investigate a haunted house with a dark terrifying history from the 1990s. Your guide will lead you into the dark. The moment you notice something strange on the floor plan, the real terror begins. There is no way out.

groupName: 有志団体いきものがかり
description: この企画では身近な植物や生き物をより知ってもらうため、校内で見られる自然の調査結果や生き物に関わる標本の展示、クイズなどを行います
descriptionEn: In this project, we will present results of investigations on wildlife in campus, display specimens, and hold quizzes in order to help visitors learn more about local fauna and flora.

description: MSTC生徒が日頃から行っている研究についてポスター発表と口頭発表をします。
descriptionEn: MSTC students will present their ongoing research through poster and oral presentations.
